title: The Void Has a Sense of Humor
logline: So let's say Jesus appears, now, in a glowing dreamscape where a crying Twitter user is running from the Void, and finds out the Void laughs at his jokes, wants a word, and gets blocked with him; plus a bonus scene in which the Void quietly drop-kicks a Depression Magician so it can have a moment with my fear.

voice_notes.NARRATOR: The same storyteller as the earlier film (the gender-neutral 50/50 blend), but this time telling a funny daydream to a friend and delighted with themselves. Present tense, conversational 'so let's say...' rhythm, a grin in the voice. They play the comic timing like a stand-up who loves the material: they hit cue words ('now.'), leave real air before punchlines, and let little laughs leak through on 'like, on their ass', 'too intensely' and 'fat leg'. When the story turns gentle (the gentle smile, the sad smile, the walk into the horizon, and 'a moment with my fear') the grin drops away and the voice goes soft and close, almost private.
voice_notes.JESUS: Warm, mid-low, unhurried, smiling; a gentle tease who is never sarcastic and never preachy. Completely unafraid: he talks to the terrified user the way you would talk to a friend's kid who just fell off a bike. 'Teehee' is genuine and mischievous, a little higher than his speaking voice. 'Do you have a moment?' is earnestly polite, like a neighbor with a clipboard. In the emotions speech he means every word and leans in a little too much; 'meaningful to me' is the most open he gets. The dumb jokes at the end are told with total commitment, quieter and quieter with distance.
voice_notes.USER: Young, quick, breathy, pitched up by panic; sarcasm is their armor and they talk fast to get it over with. 'What the actual f***' cracks upward, more disbelief than anger (the last word is the comedic bleep). 'Hell no' is instant and flat, and the rest tumbles out fast. They are silent through Jesus's speech, and that silence is acting: hear the breath catch once.
voice_notes.VOID: Never words. Its sounds are huge but soft, with a faint shimmering reverb tail, like a cathedral that giggles. The snort is wet and surprised; the giggle bubbly; the maniacal laugh a high wheezing cackle over a deep belly rumble that keeps tipping into star-coughs; whispers are soft unintelligible wind with little consonant clicks; the huffs are big nasal puffs; the contented sigh is a slow deflating breath; the final giggles are small and far away.
voice_notes.FEAR: Small, breathy, high, quick to crack, exactly as in the earlier film. 'What's that noise?' is a tiny, worried, rising question. 'Why are you showing me this?' is the same awed whisper as in the first film, thin with tears.
voice_notes.MAGICIAN: Slithery, theatrical, low-to-mid, a stage magician's flourish on every phrase; savors consonants ('juicy' wet and drawn out, a little hiss on 'Fear'). Creepy-funny, a pantomime villain, never truly menacing. His last word, 'ow', is small, muffled and sincere, from under a bucket.

scenes.purpose: Hook in one bright image: a crying young person fleeing a huge, starry, oddly shy Void across a glowing pastel dreamscape. Then the narrator's stage cue conjures Jesus ('now.') and he takes in the scene with zero fear. Viewers should be smiling by the time the user hits the ground, and should already suspect the Void is not the villain.

music.mood: tense-comic chase that stops dead for the cue, then a twinkly arrival and a warm 'old friends' chord
music.instrumentation: scurrying pizzicato strings and light tom pulses, a bassoon line for the Void's waddle; on 'now.' a harp glissando and celesta sparkle; a warm French-horn chord on the waves

beats.shot: OPENING STILL / THUMBNAIL. Frame one is the finished, fully lit image: no fade from black, nothing fading up. Low camera at hip height, 35mm feel, looking up the pale winding path to a huge low peach sun on the far horizon (sun disc centered near y=400). Sky: apricot and peach at the horizon rising through lilac to deep indigo with a sparse scatter of stars in the upper left, where the Void's presence darkens it. Title 'The Void Has a Sense of Humor' in soft cream hand-lettering across the upper sky (y=130-290), fully opaque on frame one; it holds through this beat and fades out over the first 1.5 s of the next beat. Right of center: the USER mid-stride toward camera, face at y=470-600. Upper left, on the crest of the path behind them: THE VOID, rim-lit violet-to-teal against the sunset, filling the left half from y=150 to y=780, its starlight eyes at y=330. Bottom third: pale path and mint grass only (subtitle band clear). Imperceptible 2 percent push-in; a few glowing thought seeds drift slowly through the light.
beats.action: The user runs toward camera, crying, phone clutched to the chest. Behind them the Void follows at a lumbering waddle, its short fat legs peeking from under the hem, one big four-fingered hand raised palm-out in a 'wait' gesture. Two tears flick off the user's cheeks and catch the sun.

acting.USER: Already in the run pose on frame one (eyes open, never mid-blink): eyes huge and wet, brows high and pinched together at the inner corners, mouth open in a crumpled cry, freckled cheeks streaked and glinting. Hoodie strings flying, shoulders hunched to the ears, left hand crushing the glowing phone to the sternum. At 1.6 s a panicked glance back over the right shoulder at the Void; eyes snap forward again.
acting.VOID: Not menacing at all, and that is the joke: big round starlight eyes earnest and a little worried, nebula-wisp brows lifted in the middle, a small open crescent mouth as if about to call 'wait'. One hand raised palm-out; the other lifts the hem a little like a long skirt so the fat legs can waddle. A few star motes lift off its rim with each step.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: So let's say there's a Twitter user, crying,
beats.delivery: conversational and delighted, like starting a story at a sleepover; a grin in the voice; a tiny lift on 'Twitter'; 'crying' sympathetic but light
beats.shot: Cut on the run to a tracking medium close-up, the camera dollying backward ahead of the USER at their speed; face at y=330-520, the path streaming behind, the Void a soft dark shape far back over their shoulder. The title finishes fading out in the first second.
beats.action: The user is visibly crying as they run: tears streaming, a sob hitching the shoulders mid-stride, the phone's cool light bouncing on their chin.

acting.USER: Brows knotted and inner-up; eyes squeeze half shut on each sob, then flare wide; lower lip pulled down and trembling; a hiccup-sob jolts the chest on 'crying'; a quick wet sniff; the phone stays clamped to the chest like a shield.
acting.VOID: Far back, soft focus, still waddling after them with its hand raised.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: and running from the ~void.
beats.delivery: slower, mock-ominous on 'the void', a smile breaking through by the end
beats.shot: Cut to a wide side view, the path crossing frame on a gentle rise, horizon at y=640. The USER small at right, running toward frame right; THE VOID enters from the left, so tall its hood nearly brushes the top of frame, the indigo starry patch of sky traveling with it. Both heads well above y=800.
beats.action: We see the chase: the user sprinting flat-out; the Void behind taking one waddling step for every five of theirs, which still keeps it close, because it is so big.

acting.USER: Arms pumping, phone hand high, head turned back toward the Void with the whites showing all round the irises; mouth a stretched rectangle of panic.
acting.VOID: Waddles with a side-to-side rock; eyes follow the user with a pleading, puzzled look; brows lift higher; it opens and closes its raised hand twice, a tiny 'hey... hey'.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: And let's say Jesus appears...
beats.delivery: setting up a magic trick: bright, a little grand; the voice hangs in the air on 'appears' and waits
beats.shot: Cut to a locked-off medium of an EMPTY stretch of path ahead of the user: golden backlight, mint grass, one thought seed drifting through. Hold on the emptiness through the whole pause.
beats.action: Nothing appears. That is the joke. The empty path just waits in the golden light; one thought seed floats down, bobs, and drifts off. The user's running feet and panicky breathing get closer off-screen.

acting.USER: Off-screen, heard only: running feet and wet, gasping breath approaching.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: ^Now.
beats.delivery: a crisp little stage cue, a snap of the fingers in the voice, landing exactly on the sparkle
beats.shot: Same locked-off frame.
beats.action: On the word, JESUS pops into existence in the middle of the path in a soft golden shimmer and a small puff of warm sparkles (no flash, no halo): already standing there mid-evening-stroll, hands clasped loosely behind his back, as if he has been out walking for an hour. Face at y=300-430.

acting.JESUS: Appears already relaxed: weight on one hip, easy shoulders, a pleasant closed-mouth smile, eyes half-lidded and content, enjoying the sunset. One slow, satisfied blink. He has not noticed anything yet.

beats.speaker: USER
beats.shot: Cut to a slightly low medium two-shot from the side: JESUS standing calmly at left (face y=300-430), the USER bursting into frame from the right, still looking back over their shoulder.
beats.action: The user whips their head forward, finds a whole person suddenly standing right there, and screams.

acting.USER: Head snaps forward; eyes fly wide, pupils pinpoints; brows shoot up; mouth a tall open oval; the body jolts upright mid-stride, arms flung up; the phone pops out of the hand and is caught again.
acting.JESUS: A small surprised blink at the scream; brows lift; he does not step back. A tiny polite tilt of the head: 'oh. hello.'

beats.shot: Hold the two-shot; the camera dips a little to follow the user down (their face settles at y=560-680, still well above the subtitle band).
beats.action: The user skids, their legs shoot out in front, and they land hard on their backside, sliding to a stop right at Jesus's sandals in a puff of pale dust. One hand flies up, palm out, and stays up like a tiny shield.

acting.USER: Lands with an 'oof' face: eyes squeezed shut, cheeks puffed. Then the eyes pop open and stare up at Jesus; one hand up and out, fingers splayed; the other props them up from behind, still holding the phone; legs splayed, sneakers toes-up; breathing in fast little gasps; the cry face crumples back in.
acting.JESUS: Looks down: brows lift in sympathy, inner corners up; a soft 'oh' shape of the mouth; he bends slightly at the waist, hands coming out from behind his back, open.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: And sees this.
beats.delivery: warm and amused, a shrug in the voice, as if gesturing at the whole mess
beats.shot: Over JESUS's shoulder (his head and shoulder at frame left, y=250-420), looking up the path: the USER on the ground just below him, and beyond, THE VOID arriving at the crest and slowing to a stop, towering, filling the upper frame (its eyes at y=260).
beats.action: Jesus sees the whole picture: the crying user on the ground at his feet, and the huge Void that has just stopped a few steps behind them, one hand still half-raised.

acting.JESUS: Eyes travel: down to the user, up to the Void, back down to the user; a small knowing exhale through the nose; the beginning of a smile at one corner of the mouth.
acting.USER: Twists to look back at the Void, then up at Jesus, back and forth, caught between them; tears still running.
acting.VOID: Stops; rocks back on its round heels; the raised hand sheepishly sinks halfway; two slow blinks; its eyes go from the user to Jesus.

beats.shot: Cut to a low-angle medium on THE VOID from Jesus's eye line (its eyes at y=280), then a reverse medium close-up on JESUS (face y=300-480), the USER's head and raised hand in the low foreground.
beats.action: Recognition. The Void gives Jesus a tiny, shy four-finger wave. Jesus gives it a little wave back. They know each other. The user, on the ground between them, sees both waves.

acting.VOID: Eyes brighten and the lower lids lift into happy crescents; the mouth opens into a small shy smile; wiggles four fingers at hip height, a little embarrassed to be caught chasing someone.
acting.JESUS: The smile opens all the way, laugh lines crinkling; raises a hand to shoulder height and waggles the fingers back, an old-friend wave; one soft chuckle in the shoulders.
acting.USER: Head whips from one wave to the other; mouth falls open; the crying stalls in pure confusion; one brow up, one down.

scenes.purpose: Jesus treats the scariest thing in the user's world like an old friend: walks right up, puts his arm around it, and whispers something we never get to hear. We should be dying to know what he said.

music.mood: sly, conspiratorial, light on its feet
music.instrumentation: plucked harp, muted pizzicato, soft clarinet, a brushed snare tick

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: And Jesus walks up to the void,
beats.delivery: matter-of-fact; the comedy is in how casual it sounds
beats.shot: Wide side view: the USER on the ground in the right foreground (head y=600-690), JESUS walking past them up the gentle rise toward THE VOID at left (Void eyes y=250). The camera drifts slowly left with him.
beats.action: Jesus strolls up to the Void. As he passes the user he gives a small palm-down 'one sec' gesture without breaking stride.

acting.JESUS: Easy, unhurried walk, sandals scuffing; a glance and small reassuring smile down at the user as he passes, left palm lowered twice: 'hang on'. Then his eyes go up to the Void, full of warm delight.
acting.USER: Swivels on their backside to watch him go; mouth open; one hand still raised; the other drags the phone in closer.
acting.VOID: Watches him come; fidgets its big fingers together in front of its round belly; eyes bright.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: puts his arm around the void,
beats.delivery: cheerful, a rhythm starting to build
beats.shot: Medium two-shot on JESUS and THE VOID; the Void sinks down into frame so both heads end at y=300-460.
beats.action: The Void, knowing the drill, sinks down: its round body squashes and settles like a huge beanbag until its hood is level with Jesus's head. Jesus slings his arm around its broad back.

acting.VOID: Squashes down with a soft settling wobble; eyes half close, content, at the arm; leans into him a little.
acting.JESUS: Right arm goes up and around the Void's back, hand resting on its far shoulder; pulls it in with a friendly squeeze; his cheek nearly touches the hood.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: and starts whispering in the void's ear.
beats.delivery: drops into a stage whisper on 'whispering', conspiratorial and pleased
beats.shot: Slow push in to a tight two-shot: JESUS's mouth at the side of the Void's hood (y=320-440).
beats.action: Jesus leans in, cups his free hand beside his mouth, and starts whispering into the side of the Void's hood.

acting.JESUS: Leans in, hand cupped; eyes slide sideways toward the user with a mischievous glint, then back; brows lifted in a 'get this' look; lips moving fast and small.
acting.VOID: Tilts its hood toward him to listen; eyes drift up and to the side, attentive, the way you listen to good gossip.

beats.speaker: JESUS
beats.caption: (whispering)
beats.shot: Hold the tight two-shot; at 1.4 s cut to a low reaction shot of the USER on the ground (face y=360-520) watching; at 2.6 s cut back to the two-shot.
beats.action: Jesus keeps whispering; we hear only soft sibilants, never the words. The Void listens. Alone on the path, the user watches it happen.

acting.JESUS: Whispering with little gestures of the cupped hand; a suppressed smile keeps twitching at his mouth; his eyebrows waggle once on what is clearly the setup.
acting.VOID: Eyes slowly widen; the nebula brows lift by degrees; the corners of the mouth tighten, a smile being held back.
acting.USER: In the cutaway: lowers the raised hand an inch; squints; leans forward to try to hear; wipes their nose on the hoodie sleeve; eyes dart between the two.

scenes.purpose: The joke lands, in threes: a snort with one star, a giggle with two, then a full maniacal cosmic laugh that coughs stars and little galaxies across the sky, capped by one galaxy the size of a beach ball. Say it, show it.

music.mood: a held breath, then a sparkling comic romp that peaks with the big galaxy
music.instrumentation: a single held harp note for the pause; celesta and glockenspiel bursts on each star, bouncing bassoon, timpani roll into a cymbal-swell on the big cough

beats.shot: Medium close two-shot, JESUS and THE VOID, heads at y=280-460. Locked off.
beats.action: The punchline has been delivered. Jesus pulls back and waits with an expectant little smile. The Void is perfectly still.

acting.JESUS: Pulls his head back from the hood; eyebrows up; lips pressed together, holding in his own laugh; eyes fixed on the Void's eyes, waiting.
acting.VOID: Absolutely still; eyes blank and round; one slow blink; then the lower lids begin to twitch upward.

beats.speaker: VOID
beats.caption: (snort)
beats.shot: Same frame.
beats.action: A snort bursts out and ONE tiny star pops out of the Void's hood, arcs up and twinkles away.

acting.VOID: A hand flies up to cover the mouth of its hood; eyes squeeze into crescents; shoulders jolt once.
acting.JESUS: Grins; nods encouragingly, eyebrows high: 'right?'

beats.speaker: VOID
beats.shot: Slight push-in.
beats.action: The giggle leaks out through its fingers and TWO more stars squeeze out between them and float up.

acting.VOID: Body bobs with each giggle; eyes watering starlight; brow wisps fluttering up; it tries and fails to hold it in, fingers spread over its mouth.
acting.JESUS: Starts giggling silently too, shoulders shaking, a hand on his chest.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: And then the void starts laughing ^maniacally,
beats.delivery: gleeful, picking up speed, half laughing along
beats.shot: Cut wider and lower so the whole Void fills the upper frame (eyes y=250), JESUS at its side, the USER small in the lower right foreground (head y=680).
beats.action: The dam breaks: the Void throws its head back and laughs, a huge crescent mouth opening into deep cosmos, its whole round body bouncing.

acting.VOID: Head thrown back; mouth wide open with stars visible inside; eyes squeezed into tight happy arcs streaming starlight tears; both hands clutching its belly; the hem bounces and the little fat feet lift off the ground.
acting.JESUS: Laughing too, open mouth, eyes crinkled, a hand on the Void's back.
acting.USER: Scoots backward on their backside, eyes huge, hand up.

beats.speaker: VOID
beats.shot: Same frame (under the narration).
beats.action: The laugh is audible under the narration: high wheezing cackles over a deep belly rumble.

acting.VOID: Continuous bouncing laugh as above.
acting.JESUS: Laughing with it.
acting.USER: Frozen, staring.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: while coughing up some stars and galaxies,
beats.delivery: delighted, tumbling forward
beats.shot: Low-angle medium on the Void's hood, the sunset sky behind it; the coughed-up lights fly up and across frame toward the user.
beats.action: Mid-laugh the Void coughs, and with every cough a burst of stars pops out of its mouth, then a little spiral galaxy, spinning and tumbling through the air like a dropped pinwheel.

acting.VOID: The laugh breaks into coughs: the body jerks forward on each one, a hand at its chest; the eyes pop open in surprise at each spray of stars, then crinkle shut laughing again.
acting.JESUS: Pats its back, still laughing.
acting.USER: Ducks as a little galaxy whirls over their head; follows it with their eyes, mouth hanging open.

beats.speaker: VOID
beats.shot: Same frame (under the narration).
beats.action: Laugh-coughs audible under the narration, each with a soft pop of stars.

acting.VOID: Cough, laugh, cough, as above.
acting.JESUS: Patting.
acting.USER: Ducking.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: from laughing so hard.
beats.delivery: tickled, almost losing it on 'so hard'
beats.shot: Cut to a frontal medium on THE VOID and JESUS together (heads y=260-460).
beats.action: The Void is bent forward, wheezing with laughter, and Jesus thumps its back like you would for someone who swallowed wrong.

acting.VOID: Doubled over, one hand slapping its own knee through the cloak; laughing silently now, out of air; shoulders heaving.
acting.JESUS: Two hearty back thumps; tears of laughter in his own eyes; he wipes one with a knuckle.

beats.speaker: VOID
beats.caption: (maniacal cosmic laughter)
beats.shot: Wide: the Void and Jesus upper frame, the USER in the lower foreground (head y=660); the air above them full of drifting stars and slowly spinning little galaxies glowing against the dusk.
beats.action: The peak: the Void rears back for one last huge howl of laughter and coughs up the biggest one yet, a spiral galaxy the size of a beach ball, which sails slowly over the user's head and hangs in the sky, turning.

acting.VOID: Rears up to full height, arms flung wide, mouth enormous, eyes clenched; on the big cough the whole body jolts and the big galaxy launches out.
acting.JESUS: Leans away laughing, one hand still on the Void's back, watching the big galaxy go with delighted 'ooh' brows.
acting.USER: Flattens back on the elbows as it passes over; eyes track it all the way up; jaw drops.

scenes.purpose: First big punchline: the calmest person in the dreamscape explains the cosmic horror as a great audience. 'Teehee.' A long deadpan hold on the user, then their bleeped disbelief, timed to the last wheeze of the Void's laugh and its final hiccup-star.

music.mood: the romp drains to one held note; then dry, light comic plucks
music.instrumentation: a sustained celesta note, harp harmonics; a two-note glockenspiel 'tee-hee'; a single muted-trumpet 'doink' after the bleep

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Then Jesus looks at the Twitter user,
beats.delivery: lighter, setting up, a small smile
beats.shot: Medium close on JESUS (face y=300-470); the still-giggling Void soft behind him at left; stars drifting in the air.
beats.action: Jesus, his arm still resting on the Void's back, turns his head and looks down at the user.

acting.JESUS: Laughter settling into a warm smile; turns his head; his eyes find the user; brows lift with friendly concern.
acting.VOID: Soft in the background, still shaking with silent giggles, wiping its eyes with a knuckle.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: who's, like, on their ass, with their hand up,
beats.delivery: the narrator's own laugh breaking in on 'like'; brisk, affectionate, vivid; a tiny breath before 'with their hand up'
beats.shot: Cut to Jesus's POV down onto the USER: a high-angle medium, the user sitting splayed on the pale path, face at y=380-520.
beats.action: There they are: sitting on their backside in the dust, one hand raised flat toward Jesus and the Void, the phone clutched in the other.

acting.USER: Legs splayed, sneakers toes-up; leaning back on the phone hand; the raised hand trembles, fingers splayed as if it could stop a planet; hood half fallen back, cowlick sticking straight up; shoulders up at the ears.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: and ~terror in their eyes.
beats.delivery: mock-dramatic, low and slow on 'terror', grinning underneath
beats.shot: Slow push to an extreme close-up of the USER's eyes (y=360-520). Reflected in them: drifting stars and the big spiral galaxy turning in the sky.
beats.action: Terror in the eyes, literally: huge irises, pinprick pupils, wet lids, a reflected galaxy turning slowly across each eye.

acting.USER: Eyes wide open, whites showing all around the irises; lower lids quivering; pupils shrunk to pinpoints; brows high and bunched; one tear sliding out; no blink.

beats.shot: Cut to a medium on JESUS, warm and close (face y=300-470).
beats.action: Jesus gives the user a warm, slightly sheepish smile, like a parent whose big dog just jumped on a guest.

acting.JESUS: Soft eyes, laugh lines; lips pressed in a small apologetic smile; a little nod; his free hand opens toward the user, palm up.
acting.VOID: Behind him, one last suppressed giggle bobs its shoulders.

beats.speaker: JESUS
beats.text: The void's got a pretty good sense of humor.
beats.delivery: warm, reassuring, conspiratorial, like explaining a friend's odd habit; a smile in every word; a little lean on 'pretty good'
beats.shot: Medium two-shot from the user's low eye line: JESUS at right, THE VOID behind him at left, both heads in y=220-470.
beats.action: Jesus explains the Void with a fond thumb jerked back over his shoulder at it. Behind him the Void, catching its breath, nods along and hiccups out one small star.

acting.JESUS: Lip-synced. Head tilts toward the Void; thumb points back at it on 'void's'; eyebrows bob on 'pretty good'; the smile widens on 'humor'.
acting.VOID: Wipes a starlight tear; nods eagerly; a hiccup pops a little star from its mouth, which it watches float up.

beats.speaker: JESUS
beats.text: ^Teehee.
beats.delivery: a light, genuine, mischievous little giggle-word, higher than his speaking voice, shoulders up
beats.shot: Close-up on JESUS (face y=300-480).
beats.action: Jesus says 'teehee' and means it: a little scrunch of pure joy.

acting.JESUS: Lip-synced. Shoulders scrunch up to his ears; eyes close into crescents; nose wrinkles; the fingertips of one hand touch his lips for a beat; then his eyes open again, twinkling, checking the user's reaction.

beats.shot: Cut to a medium close on the USER (face y=330-520), locked off. Hold.
beats.action: Nothing moves for a long second. A little stray star drifts down past the user's face.

acting.USER: Total stillness: the face goes slack; the eyes stay wide but the upper lids drop to a flat half-mast of disbelief; the raised hand stays frozen in the air; the mouth slowly falls open. One slow blink. The tiny star floats down in front of their nose; their eyes cross slightly to follow it, then uncross, back to Jesus.

beats.speaker: USER
beats.text: What the actual f***?!
beats.delivery: cracking upward, more disbelief than anger, a squeak on 'actual'; the last word is the comedic bleep
beats.shot: Hold the close on the USER; on the bleep, cut to the wide two-shot of Jesus and the Void (heads y=230-470).
beats.action: The user says it to the sky. Behind Jesus, the Void is just finishing laughing: the last wheezes, slowing down.

acting.USER: Lip-synced. Head juts forward; both arms fly out sideways, palms up, phone in one; brows shoot up and together; on the bleep the mouth is wide open.
acting.JESUS: Eyebrows hop up at the language, a small 'ooh' mouth, then a forgiving little smile.
acting.VOID: Last wheezing laughs, slowing; a hand on its chest; shoulders bobbing less and less.

beats.speaker: VOID
beats.shot: Same (under the user's line).
beats.action: The tail of the Void's laughter, winding down under the user's outburst.

acting.VOID: Laughter running out of steam.
acting.USER: As above.
acting.JESUS: As above.

beats.speaker: VOID
beats.caption: (contented sigh)
beats.shot: Medium on THE VOID and JESUS; at the end, a quick cut to the USER (face y=340-520).
beats.action: The Void is done laughing. One big contented sigh, a hand on its chest; then one last hiccup: a single star pops out and drifts lazily up. Cut to the user, whose flat eyes follow it up.

acting.VOID: Exhales and deflates happily, eyes half closed and dreamy; then a hiccup: eyes pop open; it watches the hiccup-star float away; a small bashful smile.
acting.JESUS: Pats its back twice, gently: 'there you go'.
acting.USER: Deadpan: eyes alone track the little star up and out of frame; nothing else on the face moves.

scenes.purpose: The tables turn: now the Void has something to say, and Jesus is its interpreter. The Void side-eyes the user the whole time it whispers, the user shrinks, and Jesus nods along like a very supportive friend. Then crossed arms, a scowl, and the politest invitation in the world.

music.instrumentation: low clarinet, walking pizzicato bass, a wood-block tick on each side-eye; a tiny fanfare-in-miniature for Jesus's announcement

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: And then the void starts whispering into Jesus's ear,
beats.delivery: conspiratorial, enjoying the reversal
beats.shot: Tight two-shot: the Void's hood bowed to JESUS's ear, both heads at y=290-460.
beats.action: The Void leans down to Jesus's ear and cups one huge four-fingered hand beside its hood, whispering.

acting.VOID: Leans in, hand cupped; eyes serious and earnest; brow wisps drawn together in a 'listen to me' shape.
acting.JESUS: Tilts his head to give it his ear; eyes go up and to the side, listening; lips pursed attentively.
